doc: Per-hunter run speed and acceleration [game data]: SUPERVIVE's CT_LokiCharacterAttributes (MoveSpeed uu/s, MaxAcceleration uu/s^2), divided by 100 for metres. Ids are our archetypes: bulwark = Oath, dredge = Kingpin, thief = Shiv, mage = Joule, dolm = Tetra, ostra = Void, ashwick = Felix, juggernaut = Brall, archer = Myth, tender = Elluna, gunslinger = Ghost, rimewright = Celeste. climb_tall: the hunter can mantle double-high ledges (bCanWallJump: Myth and Brall only). A hunter not listed uses its class speed and the default accel.

physics.doc: Ground stop, dash exit, air, fall, glide and mantle tunables shared by every hunter [game data]: BP_LokiHeroCharacter's movement component and the world settings, uu divided by 100 for metres. brake: BrakingDecelerationWalking (m/s^2), the constant part of the walking stop. ground_friction: GroundFriction 1.0 x UE's BrakingFrictionFactor 2 (1/s), the share of the speed a let-go sheds per second; together a let-go from a run stops in ~0.17 s and ~0.3 m. dash_exit_run: a dash ends at this share of run speed (never faster than the dash), so it carries into the walk, brake or jump instead of stopping dead; the data has no hard stop, and the dash curves that set the exact exit are not decoded. air_control: AirControl, the share of the hunter's ground accel its keys steer with in the air (almost none: a jump keeps its run-up). air_friction: FallingLateralFriction (1/s), how fast what you carry bleeds off in the air. fall_cap: AbyssFallSlowSpeedLimitMin (m/s), the fastest fall, easing to abyss_fall_cap between abyss_slow_from and abyss_slow_to metres under an island's lip over the abyss (AbyssFallSlowDistMin/Max). glide_height: GlideDownwardForceHeightTarget, above which the glider pulls you down at up to glide_pull_vy (GlideDownwardForceMinZVelocity); the drop past the usual sink turns into glide speed at swoop_ratio (GlideDownwardForceSwoopSpeedTransferRatio), fading over swoop_fade s. mantle_launch_keep / mantle_launch_min: MiniMantleXYSpeedTargetCoefficient / Min, the speed onto a ledge you climb (share of run speed, at least this many m/s).
